terms: There is one Web subscription, not separate hosting, management and social tiers.
The domain is always a separate up-front purchase or renewal.
M Mode is $309 per month and the client keeps 100% of business revenue.
Equity Uprise is $154.50 per month plus 50% of eligible connected online revenue, subject to program-fit review and a signed agreement.
Equity Uprise revenue sharing ends at the earlier of 12 months or $37,080 in revenue-share payments, which is 10 times the normal 12-month Web service value.
Equity Uprise is not stock, membership interest or ownership in the participating business.
Social media management is not included in Web. It is separately scoped because ongoing posting, strategy, community management and reporting are ongoing labor.
A website request is one focused change using content you supply. Major redesigns, stores and custom application features are quoted separately.
Most normal website requests target about 48 hours, Monday to Friday.
Your site's files can be handed over if the relationship ends; there are no hostage fees.
